claims.text: In an initially single-phase compositionally complex HEA, brittle behavior is controlled by nanoscale short-range order or local clustering rather than grain-boundary phenomena.
Nanoscale short-range order or local clustering impedes dislocation motion.
Local ordering can cause strain localization.
Local ordering can cause premature crack initiation even without overt intergranular precipitates.
The proposed initial state is a homogenized, as-quenched, chemically disordered, single-phase HEA without significant SRO or nanoscale clustering.
Intermediate-temperature annealing at 600–700 °C is expected to promote local ordering or SRO.
The proposed annealing treatment can promote SRO without causing macroscopic grain-boundary segregation or intermetallic precipitation.
The structural mediator is the emergence of nanoscale ordered or elementally clustered regions within the single-phase matrix.
Ordered regions act as barriers to dislocation motion.
Dislocation impediment produces localized stress concentrations.
Localized stress concentrations reduce ductility and drive a transition toward brittle fracture.
Annealing-induced embrittlement can occur while conventional grain-boundary mechanisms remain inactive.
Relative to the as-quenched baseline, the annealed alloy is predicted to have lower fracture toughness.
Relative to the as-quenched baseline, the annealed alloy is predicted to have lower ductility.
Relative to the as-quenched baseline, the annealed alloy is predicted to have higher yield strength.
Relative to the as-quenched baseline, the annealed alloy is predicted to undergo brittle fracture earlier.
The predicted mechanical degradation should correlate with the appearance of nanoscale clusters or ordered regions.
The proposed effect is expected after moderate thermal exposure or aging and during low-temperature or high-strain-rate loading.
The exact time-temperature conditions needed to induce embrittling SRO are unknown.
The threshold volume fraction of ordered regions needed to trigger brittle behavior is unknown.
